faqs.q: Why do directory sites outrank local home builders in Ottawa?
faqs.a: Large directories carry enormous authority, so they often sit above a single business for broad terms. The strategy is to win the specific, high-intent searches that describe your work and your part of Ottawa.

faqs.q: Do neighbourhood pages actually help in Ottawa?
faqs.a: Yes. Homeowners in Ottawa often search with a neighbourhood or district attached, from Centretown to The Glebe, so distinct pages for the areas you serve help you appear for those more specific searches.

faqs.q: Should I try to target all of Ottawa at once?
faqs.a: Usually not. A profile set to the entire city dilutes relevance. It is more effective to serve your real catchment first, then extend into neighbouring areas with pages of their own.

faqs.q: How do reviews affect ranking in Ottawa?
faqs.a: Reviews are both a ranking signal and a conversion driver. In Ottawa, where homeowners compare several home builders, consistent, recent and genuine reviews often tip the decision.
